1|name: IVX CI
     2|
     3|on:
     4|  workflow_dispatch:
     5|    inputs:
     6|      testTarget:
     7|        description: Backend test files or directories to run
     8|        required: false
     9|        default: default
    10|      buildApk:
    11|        description: Also build the Android release APK (set to "true")
    12|        required: false
    13|        default: "false"
    14|  push:
    15|    branches: [main]
    16|    paths:
    17|      - "backend/**"
    18|      - "expo/app.config.ts"
    19|      - "expo/android/app/build.gradle"
    20|      - "expo/ivxholding-landing/index.html"
    21|      - "expo/scripts/verify-apk-release-consistency.mjs"
    22|      - "expo/src/modules/chat/services/chatMessageUtils.ts"
    23|      - "expo/src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/**"
    24|      - "expo/__tests__/**"
    25|      - ".github/workflows/ivx-ci.yml"
    26|
    27|jobs:
    28|  backend-tests:
    29|    name: Backend tests (bun)
    30|    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    31|    timeout-minutes: 20
    32|    steps:
    33|      - name: Checkout
    34|        uses: actions/checkout@v4
    35|      - name: Setup Bun
    36|        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
    37|      - name: Install dependencies
    38|        run: bun install
    39|      - name: Run env-independent backend tests
    40|        run: |
    41|          TARGET="${{ github.event.inputs.testTarget || 'default' }}"
    42|          if [ "$TARGET" = "default" ] || [ "$TARGET" = "all" ]; then
    43|            echo "Running full backend test suite (env-independent files)..."
    44|            bun test \
    45|              backend/ivx-registration-orchestrator.test.ts \
    46|              backend/ivx-timezone.test.ts \
    47|              backend/ivx-senior-developer-capabilities.test.ts \
    48|              backend/ivx-ci-build-runner.test.ts \
    49|              backend/ivx-growth-autonomous-ops.test.ts \
    50|              backend/services/ivx-agent-certification.test.ts \
    51|              backend/services/ivx-owner-ai-intent-router.test.ts
    52|          else
    53|            echo "Running targeted tests: $TARGET"
    54|            bun test $TARGET
    55|          fi
    56|
    57|  chat-tests:
    58|    name: Chat + intent + performance tests
    59|    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    60|    timeout-minutes: 10
    61|    steps:
    62|      - name: Checkout
    63|        uses: actions/checkout@v4
    64|      - name: Setup Bun
    65|        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
    66|      - name: Install expo dependencies
    67|        run: cd expo && bun install
    68|      - name: Run intent classifier tests
    69|        run: cd expo && bun test src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/services/ivxOwnerIntentClassifier.test.ts
    70|      - name: Run chat performance optimizer tests
    71|        run: cd expo && bun test src/modules/ivx-owner-ai/services/ivxChatPerformanceOptimizer.test.ts
    72|      - name: Test canonical chat ordering
    73|        run: cd expo && bun test __tests__/chat-canonical-order.test.ts
    74|
    75|  release-consistency:
    76|    name: Android release consistency
    77|    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    78|    timeout-minutes: 5
    79|    steps:
    80|      - name: Checkout
    81|        uses: actions/checkout@v4
    82|      - name: Setup Bun
    83|        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
    84|      - name: Validate configured APK release references
    85|        run: node expo/scripts/verify-apk-release-consistency.mjs
    86|      - name: Install Expo dependencies
    87|        run: cd expo && bun install
    88|
    89|  secret-scan:
    90|    name: Secret scan
    91|    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    92|    timeout-minutes: 5
    93|    steps:
    94|      - name: Checkout
    95|        uses: actions/checkout@v4
    96|      - name: Setup Bun
    97|        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
    98|      - name: Install dependencies
    99|        run: bun install
   100|      - name: Scan for leaked secrets
   101|        run: |
   102|          # Check for common secret patterns in source files (not .env.example)
   103|          EXIT_CODE=0
   104|          for pattern in 'ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}' 'github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{82}' 'sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{48}' 'rnd_[A-Za-z0-9]{24}' 'sbp_[a-z0-9]{40}'; do
   105|            FOUND=$(grep -r --include='*.ts' --include='*.tsx' --include='*.js' --include='*.mjs' \
   106|              --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git --exclude='*.test.ts' \
   107|              --exclude='.env.example' --exclude='.env.production.template' \
   108|              -E "$pattern" . 2>/dev/null || true)
   109|            if [ -n "$FOUND" ]; then
   110|              echo "SECRET LEAK DETECTED (pattern: $pattern):"
   111|              echo "$FOUND"
   112|              EXIT_CODE=1
   113|            fi
   114|          done
   115|          if [ $EXIT_CODE -eq 0 ]; then
   116|            echo "No secrets detected in source files."
   117|          fi
   118|          exit $EXIT_CODE
   119|
   120|  android-apk:
   121|    name: Android release APK
   122|    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.inputs.buildApk == 'true'
   123|    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
   124|    timeout-minutes: 60
   125|    steps:
   126|      - name: Checkout
   127|        uses: actions/checkout@v4
   128|      - name: Setup Bun
   129|        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
   130|      - name: Setup Java 17
   131|        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
   132|        with:
   133|          distribution: temurin
   134|          java-version: "17"
   135|      - name: Setup Android SDK
   136|        uses: android-actions/setup-android@v3
   137|        with:
   138|          packages: 'platform-tools platforms;android-35 build-tools;35.0.0'
   139|      - name: Install root dependencies
   140|        run: bun install
   141|      - name: Install expo dependencies
   142|        run: cd expo && bun install
   143|      - name: Build release APK
   144|        id: build
   145|        continue-on-error: true
   146|        run: |
   147|          cd expo/android
   148|          set -o pipefail
   149|          ./gradlew assembleRelease --no-daemon -x lint 2>&1 | tee gradle-build.log
   150|          GRADLE_EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
